title: nf-xen sample sheet
description: Sample sheet for nf-xen. Column order below is the order in which values are returned by samplesheetToList — keep main.nf in sync.

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must contain only word characters (letters, digits, underscore)

input.errorMessage: input must be a path to an .h5ad file

steps.errorMessage: steps must be a comma-separated list drawn from: qc, clustering, celltyping, spatial

region_col.description: obs column with region annotations used for region-stratified QC plots

min_counts.description: Min transcript counts per cell. -1 disables the filter

max_counts.description: Max transcript counts per cell. -1 disables the filter

min_genes.description: Min genes per cell. -1 disables the filter

max_genes.description: Max genes per cell. -1 disables the filter

min_cell_area.description: Min cell area (um^2). -1 disables the filter

max_cell_area.description: Max cell area (um^2). -1 disables the filter

min_area_ratio.description: Min nucleus/cell area ratio. -1 disables the filter

max_area_ratio.description: Max nucleus/cell area ratio. -1 disables the filter

max_nucleus_area.description: Max nucleus area (um^2). -1 disables the filter

min_cells_per_gene.description: Min cells expressing a gene. -1 disables the filter

max_control_fraction.description: Max fraction of control probes + control codewords per cell (0-1). -1 disables the filter

clustering_resolutions.errorMessage: clustering_resolutions must be empty or a comma-separated list of numbers

celldex_ref.description: celldex reference(s) for SingleR: '<name>__<version>' (auto-downloaded) or path to a local HDF5SummarizedExperiment .tar.gz. Multiple refs joined with '--'

celldex_labels.description: colData label column(s) for the reference(s), joined with '--' (e.g. 'label.main--label.fine')

celltypist_model.description: CellTypist model name(s) (e.g. 'Immune_All_Low.pkl') or path(s) to local .pkl model(s), joined with '--'. Empty uses the global --celltypist_model
